12.t: Working with data: wolves and deer
q: How many elk were there in 1995?
Describe the change in elk after 1995.
Elk fell steadily from about 17 000 to about 5000.
Explain the change in elk numbers.
Wolves are predators of elk; more wolves meant more elk eaten.
Willow trees grew back after 1995. Suggest why, using a food web.
Fewer elk grazing (and elk avoided open river banks), so more young willows survived: a predator affects plants two levels down (trophic cascade).
